analysisConfig.calibrationNote: Every anchor below is a documented provisional Stage-A reference, chosen from production-envelope geometry or the canonical runtime constants BEFORE any level was analyzed. None is fitted to player data or tuned to make a First 10 level hit its target. Changing any value requires a new version of this file; the locked coefficients live only in difficulty_score_model_v1.json and are never duplicated here.

accessibilityEarlyWeight.meaning: decision states with progress < scoreModel.accessibilityScarcity.priorityProgressFraction weigh 2.0, later states weigh 1.0

unlockReferenceWave.meaning: p95/mean unlock waves are divided by the deepest possible peel wave of the 59x59 production envelope, floor((59-1)/2)

routeLengthReferenceDiagonals.meaning: avg_route_length_norm = clamp((avg route length / board diagonal) / 2.0)

routeTurnReference.meaning: avg_turn_norm = clamp(avg equivalent right-angle turns per route / 8.0)

sessionActionsReference.meaning: actions_norm = clamp(dispatches / 3481): one dispatch per cell of the 59x59 envelope maximum

sessionRouteTimeReferenceSeconds.meaning: route_time_norm = clamp(cumulative bot travel seconds / 48400): 3481 dispatches each travelling one 59x59 diagonal (83.4 cells) at 6 cells/s, rounded

sessionDecisionReference.meaning: decision_count_norm = clamp(player placements / 117) = ceil(3481 / 30): fewest placements a max-envelope board needs at the max batch size

sensitivity.note: Each provisional anchor is re-scored at 0.5x and 2x (one at a time) from the recorded raw measurements; accessibilityEarlyWeight uses 1.0 (no emphasis) and 4.0.

operationalDefinitions.referencePath: canonical SolvabilitySolver trace (oracle policy, doc 09 section 13) replayed through ProofKernel; owner intended click path analyzed as a sensitivity path where a plan exists
operationalDefinitions.decisionState: every quiescent ProofState at which the reference path makes a player placement
operationalDefinitions.reachability: ProductionTargetAccess.is_targetable (production routing + RouteValidator), from the canonical ProofKernel slot origin
operationalDefinitions.W: ChallengeScoreModelV1.workload_submetric(cell count); dispatch count and route distance recorded as supporting measurements only
operationalDefinitions.A: A_t = 1 - reachable/raw over the ACTIVE cells of every color the player can currently act on (legal front batches plus occupied slot batches); progress-weighted mean
operationalDefinitions.U: earliest reachability wave per cell: wave 0 = cells targetable on the untouched board; each later wave = cells targetable after every earlier-wave cell is CLEARED (colour-agnostic ACTIVE-blocker / CLEARED-open peel); p95 by nearest rank
operationalDefinitions.B: productive action = legal front column whose color has >= 1 reachable target from the placement slot; low-choice <= 2 productive, forced == 1 productive; forced_streak_norm = longest forced streak / decision count
operationalDefinitions.R: every reference-path claim's production route (ProductionRoutingSystem.compute_route + RouteValidator) from its slot origin: length, straight-line origin->target distance, detour = length / straight, turns = total absolute heading change / 90 degrees
operationalDefinitions.S: no_work_slot_fraction = decision states with >= 1 occupied slot whose batch has no reachable target; single_productive_slot_fraction = decision states where exactly one distinct color can progress; color_demand_imbalance = robot-weighted mean over legal front batches of clamp(1 - reachable/robots)
operationalDefinitions.sessionLoad: actions = dispatches (== cells), routeTime = cumulative reference-path route seconds at bot speed, decisionCount = reference-path placements
operationalDefinitions.attemptDurationProxySeconds: sum over placements of (dispatch waves * base cadence + longest route of the final wave / bot speed): the kernel's wait-for-quiescence timing, not a human time
operationalDefinitions.frustrationRisk: PROVISIONAL_STAGE_A: only choice_opacity is supported (0.5 * B + 0.5 * non-productive legal choice fraction); retry_risk (simulated human clear rate), session_overrun (no owner slot budget) and late_failure (no failing simulation population) are UNSUPPORTED and no scalar F is claimed
operationalDefinitions.profiles: FLOW = 1 - mean(A,U,B); COLOR = mean(C,S); FORTRESS = mean(U,B); ROUTE = mean(R,A); MARATHON = W - mean(B,U); dominant = argmax, BALANCED when the top two differ by < 0.05
operationalDefinitions.similarity: challenge-vector similarity = 1 - euclidean distance / sqrt(7); palette similarity = Jaccard of used C-IDs; dimension similarity = 1 when equal else min/max area ratio; combined = mean of the three

recovery.note: Computed from ACTUAL analyzed D, never target D. The 10 -> next-cycle-1 guard needs Level 11 (CONTENT_MISSING) and is not evaluated.
